description: A 3HP attenuator that passes one signal through at the level set, with a VCA input for controlling that level from the patch

params.text: Scales the signal from silence at one end of its travel to full at the other; with nothing patched to input the module puts out a steady voltage instead, 0V to 10V across the same travel

inputs.text: The voltage here divided by 10 multiplies the level, so 10V passes the signal at the level the knob sets and 0V silences it

menu: Exponential — gives the level knob a logarithmic taper, so the lower part of its travel changes the level more slowly
